title: NC-PLUS-ORIGIN-generic-2026-11-15-t684: Automate k_eff gate: run the existing probe on every deploy and block regressions below k_eff=1
body:
**Owner:** operations
**Trigger:** the backlog item PLUS-ORIGIN-generic-2026-11-15-t684 was parked needs-code by the in-tick doer
**Done check:** Deploy pipeline runs the k_eff probe post-deploy and fails/blocks if k_eff < 1; last 3 deploys show probe results logged
**Status:** open

Automate k_eff gate: run the existing probe on every deploy and block regressions below k_eff=1

Triage: Requires editing CI/deploy pipeline to invoke the k_eff probe and gate deploys; in-Worker doer is DB-only and cannot modify code or workflows. | first step: Human/agent with repo access: locate the probe script and current deploy workflow, then add a post-deploy probe step that fails the run if k_eff < 1.

Bridged from the backlog by scripts/needs_code_bridge.py (NEEDS-CODE-BRIDGE-1). The change is code, data or a test that a loop consumes; a document alone does not close it.
